beaches.name: Tertsa, western beach
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the beach west of the village, beyond the rocks. The beach nearest the village is clothed; a naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2005 to 2016, the last describing a hand-painted 'nudists' sign on the rocks, and a 2012 Cretan magazine entry answers 'nudism: yes'. No report is newer than 2016 and no authority designation is documented.
